profile.name: Indian Institute of Information Technology Tiruchirappalli
profile.summary: IIIT Tiruchirappalli is a public-private-partnership technology institute at Sethurapatti in Tamil Nadu. Its current admissions pages list four B.Tech. routes and two M.Tech. programmes, alongside doctoral research areas. Applicants need to distinguish central counselling, DASA and institute-run self-support admissions.
profile.campusLifestyle: The institute has operated from its permanent Sethurapatti campus since June 2021. Its hostel page lists residence halls, a mess hall and a gym. The campus is on the Trichy–Madurai highway rather than at the former NIT or Oxford Engineering College locations.
profile.hostelOverview: The institute publishes a hostel accommodation form and separate hostel-and-mess charges for the 2026–27 first semester. Residence rules set permissions and return-time requirements. Confirm room allocation and the latest rules with the hostel office before arranging accommodation.
profile.dietarySupport: A campus mess is listed, and the first-semester schedules include mess advance charges. The reviewed sources do not establish allergy handling or specific dietary accommodation; students should check those needs with the hostel office.
profile.safetyOverview: Published hostel regulations prohibit ragging and direct residents to report incidents. They also provide for emergency contact information at room allotment. These policies are not a guarantee of safety or a substitute for checking current reporting contacts.
profile.studentSupport: The admission pages provide reporting instructions, cancellation forms and hostel forms. The undergraduate page also links the National Scholarship Portal notice; eligibility and an award are not guaranteed by admission.
whyChoose: A focused current portfolio in computing and electronics.
Distinct central-counselling and self-support postgraduate routes.
A permanent campus with published residence and mess information.
thingsToConsider: Choose the correct B.Tech. counselling route: DASA and domestic central counselling have different eligibility rules.
First-semester fees must not be read as annual tuition.
Doctoral research areas do not confirm an open supervisor position.
bestFitFor: Applicants seeking a computing or electronics engineering route.
Students prepared to follow the relevant central counselling process.
Research applicants able to verify a suitable supervisor and admission call.
recognitionBadges: Established under the IIIT Public-Private Partnership statutory framework

faq.question: Where is the current campus?
faq.answer: The permanent campus is at Sethurapatti on the Trichy–Madurai highway, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620012. The institute says it moved there in June 2021.

faq.question: Which B.Tech. programmes are listed?
faq.answer: The current official admission data lists Computer Science and Engineering, CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and ECE with VLSI Design. Each is listed as four years.

faq.question: Which M.Tech. programmes are listed?
faq.answer: The institute lists two-year M.Tech. programmes in Computer Science and Engineering and VLSI Systems. Self-support admission is a route into these programmes, not a separate degree.

faq.question: Is a DASA admission route available?
faq.answer: The revised DASA 2026 seat matrix lists all four B.Tech. branches at IIIT Tiruchirappalli. Its nationality, overseas-schooling, subject, marks and JEE Main requirements apply. The 2026 dates have passed; future applicants need the next published rules.

faq.question: Are the published B.Tech. fees annual?
faq.answer: No. The captured 2026–27 schedule is explicitly for the first, odd semester. It separates tuition, one-time charges, other institute charges and hostel-and-mess payments.

faq.question: How are DASA fees distinguished?
faq.answer: The DASA schedule identifies CIWG, non-SAARC and SAARC categories with different tuition amounts and currencies. Category qualification must be checked rather than assuming one fee applies to every international applicant.

faq.question: What is the self-support M.Tech. route?
faq.answer: The 2026 self-support prospectus accepts relevant engineering qualifications subject to its academic thresholds. GATE holders have a different assessment route from non-GATE applicants, and institute stipend support is not provided for this category.

faq.question: Does the institute provide hostels?
faq.answer: The official hostel page lists residence and mess facilities, and admission pages provide an accommodation form. A room allocation or particular room type should not be assumed before confirmation.

faq.question: Are doctoral places currently open?
faq.answer: The institute lists doctoral fields and links its regulations. Those listings alone do not establish that a current intake or a particular supervisor position is open; check a current admission notice.

faq.question: Is teaching language confirmed here?
faq.answer: Programme-specific instruction-language evidence was not established from the reviewed current sources. Ask the department about lectures, assessment and any language requirements before accepting an offer.

profile.cityProfile: The permanent campus is at Sethurapatti on the Tiruchirappalli–Madurai highway in Tamil Nadu. The institute’s 2026 reporting guide places it about 20 kilometres from Tiruchirappalli Junction and the central bus stand. Travel planning should use this campus, not its former NIT or Oxford Engineering College locations.
profile.practicalExposure: IIIT Tiruchirappalli describes an agreement with SVNIT Surat covering joint research, academic activities and innovation. Its stated scope includes internship opportunities for B.Tech. and M.Tech. students and collaborative projects. These are opportunities within the collaboration, not a guarantee of an internship, placement or supervisor allocation for every student.

admissionsContent.overview: For this four-year B.Tech., the 2026 DASA matrix confirms international-category seats. Admission requires central registration, document verification, choices and allotment; the separate domestic counselling route is not substituted by DASA.

eligibility.intro: The following requirements describe the completed 2026 DASA cycle; use the next published brochure for future applications.
items: Valid JEE Main 2026 Paper 1 score and rank.
Class XII/equivalent: Mathematics, Physics and one of Chemistry, Biotechnology, Computer Science or Biology; 75% aggregate across five subjects or CGPA 7.5/10 under the brochure.
Date of birth on or after 1 October 2001 for the 2026 cycle.
Foreign nationals may study in India or abroad; Indian nationals and OCI/PIO(I) need the prescribed two years of overseas education including Classes XI and XII.

applicationSteps: Register directly through the official DASA/CSAB portal and pay the applicable registration charges.
